sourceRefs.locator: ER 1931, Gregory IX.40, text and Discussion: the clerics’ mission probably in 568, Eufronius of Tours, and the reception in Poitiers in 569.
Introduction and “Playing the crowd”, “Beyond the gates”, “Reaching east”: Fortunatus and Baudonivia, the donations (Vita I.12–13), the Rule and communal gifts, and the eastern mission (Vita II.16).

summary.de: Für 569 ist der Empfang eines als Teil des Kreuzes Christi verehrten Holzstücks in Radegundes Kloster bezeugt.
summary.en: The reception at Radegund’s convent of a piece of wood venerated as part of Christ’s cross is attested in 569.
